title: Rainbow Noise: Stress-Testing Multimodal Harmful-Meme Detectors on LGBTQ Content
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of multimodal meme detectors (including LLM-based models like GPT-4 and BLIP-2) when faced with adversarial text and image noise. While it deals with identifying hate speech targeting the LGBTQ+ community, it is a technical evaluation of model resilience rather than a study or benchmark of religious beliefs, faith traditions, or ethical/moral philosophies.
